name: Valter
summary: Valter works with Bali Business Consulting (@balibusinessconsulting, ~12k followers, Instagram account operating since 2011/2014, Russian-speaking, Bali-based) and was referred by Mitcha/Mitch for an Instagram permanent-ban recovery. The account had been suspended twice by AI moderation in May and was permanently disabled; he paid $4,000 in USDT (TRC20, after a $50 test transfer) for the 24-72hr recovery option. The account was successfully restored on 2026-07-10 and he was advised to separate accounts across different Account Centers (separate emails/phone numbers) and make no major changes for a week. Conversation ended with him still asking follow-up questions about what caused the ban — good candidate for post-unban protocol guidance and repeat business.
key_facts: Account: @balibusinessconsulting, ~12k followers, 12+ years old, business account running ads
Permanently disabled by Instagram after two prior AI-driven suspensions in May
Two pricing options quoted: $4,000 for 24-72hr turnaround, $3,500 for 3-7 days
Chose the $4,000 option; refund promised if unsuccessful
Paid in USDT on TRC20/Tron via Exodus wallet (TKg3MRS33SeRCDeSzMTrNNpckKbUKypBsJ); sent $50 test transfer first
Could not pay via ERC20; ERC20 address 0xceB86A7658bcd09E2C16AE336Eb690508424A69e was declined
Gave account login credentials to complete recovery (login bugged on his end even in Safari)
Root cause given: multiple work accounts sharing one Account Center; advised separate emails/phone numbers per account
Advised no major account changes for one week post-recovery
Open thread: on 2026-07-13 he was still asking for a fuller explanation of the cause
services_discussed: Instagram permanent ban recovery / account reinstatement
